_comment: Trainable problem -> resolution map for the iPay bot. Edit this file to teach (or update) how the bot resolves user problems in the Issues menu and in AI answers. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored. Each entry may have: title, resolution (step-by-step), keywords (used for guide search), and escalate (bool, default true).

deposit.title: Deposit / Payment Not Reflected
deposit.resolution:
◆ iPAY – DEPOSIT ISSUE

➡️ IMPORTANT CHECKS
▪️ Check the payment details and order expiry.
▪️ Use your iPay-linked wallet only.
▪️ Do not use Pocket UPI.

🎯 NEXT STEPS
✅ Paid? Submit your UTR and payment screenshot.
⏳ Payment pending? Check the status before paying again.
📞 Still facing issues? Contact iPay support.

◆ CHECK FIRST – PAY SAFELY!

withdrawal.title: Delayed Withdrawal
withdrawal.resolution:
🧾 iPAY – DELAYED WITHDRAWAL

➡️ IMPORTANT CHECKS
▪️ Check your daily UPI receiving limit.
▪️ Make sure UPI is active.
▪️ Ensure your bank account can receive payments.
▪️ Check your wallet connection.
▪️ Try relinking your wallet if needed.

🎯 WHAT TO DO
▪️ ⏳ Wait for the status update.
▪️ 📞 Contact iPay support if the delay continues.

◆ CHECK • VERIFY • STAY UPDATED!

referral.title: Referral Problems & Rewards
referral.resolution:
👥 iPAY – REFERRAL GUIDE

➡️ HOW TO INVITE
▪️ Open iPAY App → Team section.
▪️ Find and share your referral link with new users.
▪️ Existing users cannot be referred again. No upper limit on referrals.

🎁 REWARDS & REQUIREMENTS
▪️ Invited user must complete 15 orders after registration.
▪️ Referred user reward: ₹100 | Referrer reward: ₹50.
▪️ Reward is credited automatically once conditions are fulfilled.

🔍 MISSING REWARD OR NOT SHOWING?
▪️ Go to: Assets → Bonus → Referral Banner → View Detail.
▪️ If referral is not showing, check internet connection or switch networks.

◆ INVITE • EARN • GROW YOUR TEAM!

general_support.title: General iPAY Support
general_support.resolution:
ℹ️ iPAY – GENERAL SUPPORT

➡️ WHAT IS iPAY?
▪️ An application where users earn money by placing orders.
▪️ Example: ₹1,000 order = ₹1,040 including 4% commission.

📞 24/7 HUMAN SUPPORT
▪️ Available 24/7 via official group or admin direct messages (DMs).
▪️ Usual response time: Approximately 3–5 minutes.

📝 REPORTING A PROBLEM
▪️ Provide: UID, screenshot of the issue, and clear explanation.
⚠️ NEVER share passwords, OTPs, or UPI PINs.

rewards.title: Missing Reward
rewards.resolution:
MISSING REWARD

CHECK THESE KEY POINTS
- Review the offer's eligibility and completion conditions in the app.
- Check your progress and the reward status.
- Ask support to clarify any task threshold or calculation.

WHAT TO DO NEXT
- A task threshold is not a separate unlocking fee; do not pay anyone to unlock a reward.
- Ask support to check the missing reward.

commission.title: Commission Discrepancy
commission.resolution:
COMMISSION

KEY POINTS
- Rates and bonuses can vary by offer and completed order.
- Check the current commission details in the app before starting.

WHAT TO DO NEXT
- Ask support to confirm the rate or eligibility for a specific order.

upi.title: UPI Blocked / Locked
upi.resolution:
UPI BLOCKED OR LOCKED

CHECK THESE KEY POINTS
- Check the wallet status and follow the instructions shown in the iPay app.
- Contact your bank or wallet provider if they show a restriction.

IMPORTANT
- Avoid repeated attempts while the account is locked.
- Only make a ₹1 transfer to your own UPI if the app instructs you to.
- Contact support if the issue remains.

locked.title: Order Locked
locked.resolution:
◆ iPAY – ORDER LOCKED UPDATE

⚠️ Possible causes:
▪️ Wallet logout during transactions.
▪️ Connection interruptions.
▪️ Bank daily limit reached.

🔄 Relink your wallet and verify your UPI and bank account.
▪️ Check your bank transaction limits.

⏳ Allow up to 24 hours for processing.
📞 Still locked? Contact Support with Order ID and UID.

◆ STAY UPDATED!

account.title: Account / Password Issue
account.resolution:
ACCOUNT ACCESS

CHECK THESE KEY POINTS
- If signed in, use the password-change option in your account settings and follow the verification steps.
- If you cannot sign in, contact support for account-recovery help.

IMPORTANT
- Never share your password, OTP, or PIN here.

technical_error.title: Technical Errors & App Troubleshooting
technical_error.resolution:
🛠️ iPAY – TECHNICAL TROUBLESHOOTING

➡️ COMMON SOLUTIONS
▪️ App not loading / slow / stuck: Check your network connection. Try switching to another network and try again.
▪️ App crashes / closes automatically: Wait for some time and try again.
▪️ Recommended troubleshooting: Clear the cache, restart the app, or update it.
▪️ Feature/button not opening: Wait for some time and try again.
▪️ Repeated errors: Try using another mobile device.

📞 CUSTOMER SUPPORT
▪️ Take a screenshot of the error or problem and share it with customer support.
▪️ If unresolved after multiple attempts, contact customer support for guidance.

wallet_issue.title: Wallet Management & Troubleshooting
wallet_issue.resolution:
👛 iPAY – WALLET SUPPORT

➡️ WALLET MANAGEMENT
▪️ Add wallet: Go to Tools section below the bar, click Add, and add your wallet.
▪️ Check wallets: Check previous order and withdrawal wallets in the iPAY application.
▪️ Remove wallet: Cannot permanently remove a bound wallet from iPAY; you can log out of the wallet.

🔄 CONNECTION & LOCK ISSUES
▪️ Connection failed: Go to relevant section in the app and click Relink to reconnect.
▪️ Locked wallet: Caused by multiple failed orders, rate limitations, or abnormal connection.
▪️ Balance / points incorrect: Check the Bills section for verification.

📞 ESCALATION
▪️ If your wallet is still locked after 24 hours, contact customer support for assistance.
